changelog: Watchlist fixes: 503 when plex.tv is unreachable during linking; relinking mid-sync keeps the first-sync merge; Plex titles without ids are retried; faster Watchlist loading; no early drop-off from a dateless played save.
description: Tells signed-in users who owns a playlist they can see, so shared lists keep their creator even after Jellyfin drops a playlist's shares, and keeps each user's Watchlist, which can hold titles not on the server and can sync with their own Plex watchlist.
name: Sashimi Lists
overview: Playlist owner lookups and per-user Watchlists for Sashimi clients.
